The main takeaway from our work is that

the Sn-0. 7Cu solder has the best interfacial stability with the ENIG-plated Cu substrate among the three kinds Pb-free solders, which is very important for the reliability and performance of the Pb-free solder joint in high-temperature electronics packaging.
a Cu-free solder, such as Sn-3.0Ag-0.5Cu, is recommended for use with ENIG-plated Cu in high temperature electronic applications.

the addition of 0.7 wt.% Cu to the Sn-3.0Ag solder is not a good choice for improving the interfacial stability at 200°C, and a higher Cu content in the solder is needed to further improve the solder/substrate interfacial stability.
